description:
Watch this compilation all about the Beets Crew as they battle breakdowns, floods and huge risks while chasing massive gold totals and proving why they’re one of the toughest crews in the Klondike! From equipment failures and emergency fixes to high-stakes gambles on new ground, Tony Beets and his crew never back down and keep pushing for big gold no matter what gets in their way.
